diff --git a/fastapi/_compat.py b/fastapi/_compat.py
index 8ea5bf25..68cdff4e 100644
--- a/fastapi/_compat.py
+++ b/fastapi/_compat.py
@@ -587,6 +587,8 @@ def _annotation_is_complex(annotation: Union[Type[Any], None]) -> bool:
 
 def field_annotation_is_complex(annotation: Union[Type[Any], None]) -> bool:
     origin = get_origin(annotation)
+    if origin is Annotated:
+        return field_annotation_is_complex(get_args(annotation)[0])
     if origin is Union or origin is UnionType:
         return any(field_annotation_is_complex(arg) for arg in get_args(annotation))
 
diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
index e49380cb..2433724c 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
@@ -828,6 +828,10 @@ def is_union_of_base_models(field_type: Any) -> bool:
     """Check if field type is a Union where all members are BaseModel subclasses."""
     from fastapi.types import UnionType
 
+    # Unwrap an outer Annotated (e.g. Annotated[Union[...], Discriminator(...)])
+    if get_origin(field_type) is Annotated:
+        field_type = get_args(field_type)[0]
+
     origin = get_origin(field_type)
 
     # Check if it's a Union type (covers both typing.Union and types.UnionType in Python 3.10+)
@@ -837,6 +841,9 @@ def is_union_of_base_models(field_type: Any) -> bool:
     union_args = get_args(field_type)
 
     for arg in union_args:
+        # Unwrap Annotated union members (e.g. Annotated[Model, Tag("name")])
+        if get_origin(arg) is Annotated:
+            arg = get_args(arg)[0]
         if not lenient_issubclass(arg, BaseModel):
             return False
